name: Data Analyzer: The old built-in admin password is rejected when no admin password is configured
objective: Shows there is no secret default password left in the product that would let anyone in.
precondition: Program store (the small database that holds saved programs) created in a temporary folder; admin-password environment variables set as stated in each step. No network, no AI model.

steps.action: Remove both admin-password settings, then check the old built-in password.
steps.data: Old built-in password text (no longer valid)

name: Data Analyzer: The old-style ADMIN_PW setting alone no longer switches admin access on
objective: Shows only the documented setting name enables admin access.
precondition: Program store (the small database that holds saved programs) created in a temporary folder; admin-password environment variables set as stated in each step. No network, no AI model.

steps.action: Set only the old setting ADMIN_PW to a made-up value, then check that same value.

name: Data Analyzer: The documented admin password setting is the one that is checked
objective: Shows the right password is accepted and a wrong one is refused.
precondition: Program store (the small database that holds saved programs) created in a temporary folder; admin-password environment variables set as stated in each step. No network, no AI model.

steps.action: Set DATA_ANALYZER_ADMIN_PASSWORD to a made-up value and check the right and a wrong password.
steps.expected: Right password returns True; wrong password returns False.

name: Data Analyzer: An empty password does not match an empty admin-password setting
objective: Shows a blank setting cannot be bypassed by sending a blank password.
precondition: Program store (the small database that holds saved programs) created in a temporary folder; admin-password environment variables set as stated in each step. No network, no AI model.

steps.action: Set the admin password setting to empty and check an empty password.

name: Data Analyzer: A password with accented characters is refused without crashing
objective: Shows unusual characters in a login attempt give a clean refusal, not an error.
precondition: Program store (the small database that holds saved programs) created in a temporary folder; admin-password environment variables set as stated in each step. No network, no AI model.

steps.action: Set a made-up admin password and check an attempt containing an accented letter.
steps.expected: The check returns False and no exception is raised.

name: Data Analyzer: Admin password comparison uses the safe timing-resistant method and the old password is absent from the code
objective: Shows the source code uses the standard safe comparison and no longer contains the old built-in password. This reads the source file; it does not run a timing measurement.
precondition: Source file available. Static text check only.

steps.action: Read the text of the program-store source file src/program_cache.py.
steps.expected: It contains 'secrets.compare_digest' and does not contain the old built-in password text.

name: Data Analyzer: Admin actions are refused with HTTP 503 when no admin password is set (local machine)
objective: Shows the server fails safe: with no admin password configured it denies admin access instead of allowing it.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Set the server's admin password to none and call the admin check with the header value 'anything'.
steps.expected: The check is refused with HTTP 503 (service unavailable).

name: Data Analyzer: Admin actions are refused with HTTP 503 when no admin password is set (deployed environment)
objective: Shows the same fail-safe behaviour when the server believes it is running in the cloud.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Set the admin password to empty, mark the environment as a deployed container app, and call the admin check with no header.
steps.expected: The check is refused with HTTP 503.

name: Data Analyzer: Admin check accepts only the configured password
objective: Shows the right password is let through and a wrong password gets HTTP 403 (forbidden).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Configure admin password 's3cret-admin' and call the check with that password.
Call the check with a wrong password.

name: Data Analyzer: A non-English-character admin password header gets HTTP 403, not a crash
objective: Shows odd characters in the admin header produce a normal refusal.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Configure a made-up admin password and call the check with a header containing accented letters.

name: Data Analyzer: API key check is refused with HTTP 503 when no API key is set in a deployed environment
objective: Shows a production server with a missing API key setting denies requests instead of letting everyone in.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Set the server's API key to none, mark the environment as production (APP_ENV=prod) and call the API-key check with no key.
steps.expected: The check is refused with HTTP 503.
